facts.text: The hotel occupies the former Convent de la Missio in the historic centre of Palma.
facts.excerpt: Our elegant design hotel is located in the former Convent de la Missió in the historic centre of Palma.

facts.text: The building was built in the 17th century and was originally dedicated to training missionaries.
facts.excerpt: Built during the 17th century, the building was originally dedicated to the training of missionaries.

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of numerous restaurants, shops, markets, art galleries and historical monuments.
facts.excerpt: within walking distance to numerous restaurants, shops, markets, art galleries, historical monuments and more

facts.text: The rooftop has a solarium with sun loungers, an outdoor swimming pool heated in winter, a chill-out area and a small gym.
facts.excerpt: Our rooftop has a solarium area equipped with comfortable sun loungers and an outdoor swimming pool for cooling off, heated in winter, as well as a chill out area and a small gym.

facts.text: The spa area has a sauna, an indoor swimming pool and a relaxation room.
facts.excerpt: The Hotel Convent de la Missió has sauna services, indoor swimming pool and relaxation room

facts.text: Spa treatments include massages, facials and body exfoliations adapted to the guest's skin type.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a massage, a facial treatment or a body exfoliation adapted to your skin type.

facts.text: Guests can enjoy the cuisine of chef Marc Fosh at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: You can enjoy the exquisite cuisine of Marc Fosh

facts.text: The Art Bar is a gallery showing painting, ceramics and sculpture by local contemporary artists, where guests can have wine or signature cocktails.
facts.excerpt: An exclusive gallery to enjoy the works of some local contemporary artists, while sipping a good wine or one of our signature cocktails.

facts.text: Rooms have a king-size bed, free Wi-Fi, television, air conditioning and heating.
facts.excerpt: These include a comfortable king size bed, free Wi-Fi and television, as well as air conditioning and heating.

facts.text: Each room has a coffee machine and toiletries.
facts.excerpt: You’ll also find a coffee machine and toiletries in each room.

facts.text: Room types are Double Superior, Double Deluxe, Junior Suite, Suite Premium and Luxury Suite.
facts.excerpt:

facts.text: The convent's old chapel can be booked as a multipurpose room for meetings, conventions or seminars.
facts.excerpt: The old chapel of the Convent de la Missió is suitable as a multipurpose room that can be booked for meetings, conventions or seminars.

facts.text: Reception is open 24 hours.
facts.excerpt:
Reception

24 hours

facts.text: The hotel is 12 km from Palma airport.
facts.excerpt: The Hotel Convent de la Missió is located 12 km from the airport.

facts.text: The address is Carrer de la Missio, 7A, Palma de Mallorca.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a 5-star boutique hotel.

facts.excerpt: Dive into the essence of the Mediterranean thanks to the gastronomic proposal
